description: Get one server's full listing and its status in every directory that fits it. Status is one of: live (ManyCP confirmed the listing exists), pr_open (a pull request is waiting on maintainers), submitted (sent, waiting), in_progress, queued, needs_update (the listing is behind the latest version), action_required (the user must do something, the reason is included), rejected, skipped, or not_started. Also returns links: pull requests, live listing pages, the dashboard page. Read-only, works on every plan. `server` accepts an id, a slug, a GitHub repo, or the exact name.

server.description: Which server: its id (srv_...), its slug, its GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/name or owner/name), or its exact name. list_servers shows them all.

name: get_server
title: Get a server and its listings
